papers.abstract: Pretrained VLMs bring rich world knowledge and semantic priors to object-goal navigation, and fine-tuning a VLM into a navigation policy has become a common recipe. Despite this progress, success rates remain low, and it is unclear which capability these fine-tuned policies lack. Our diagnosis identifies goal grounding as the dominant failure. These policies explore well, yet often fail to notice that the goal is already in view or to estimate how far away it is. To address this failure, we ground the goal explicitly. Explicit grounding substantially improves success and reaches state-of-the-art results on six benchmarks across three scene collections. We also correct annotation defects in these benchmarks, so that future methods are evaluated more faithfully. Our analysis on the clean benchmarks shows that, with ground-truth grounding, our policy nearly matches the expert that generated its demonstrations, leaving the headroom in perception rather than policy learning. Our work points to goal grounding as a missing piece of object-goal navigation and offers a simple and effective solution to the task.

analysis.key_results: 在六个基准、三个场景集合上达到最先进成功率；使用真实接地时策略接近生成演示的专家水平。
analysis.main_contribution: 识别目标接地为对象目标导航的主要失败模式，并提出显式目标接地方法，在多个基准上取得最先进结果；同时修正基准中的标注缺陷，提供更忠实的评估。
analysis.method: 显式目标接地：使策略能够注意到目标已在视野内并估计其距离，而非仅依赖隐式视觉语言模型策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该工作诊断并解决对象目标导航中策略的目标接地失败问题，通过显式目标接地显著提升成功率。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding typically characterizes speedup by draft tokens accepted per verification round. Lossless verification preserves the target model's output distribution and thus expected completion length, making this metric a meaningful efficiency proxy. Relaxed (lossy) verification accepts tokens that lossless verification would reject, potentially altering that distribution. We identify a length inflation phenomenon: relaxed verification lengthens completions, primarily by extending reasoning traces, largely offsetting apparent gains in accepted tokens per round. We evaluate existing training-free relaxed verification rules on twelve target-drafter pairs against lossless verification on identical prompts, measuring completion length, verifier rounds, wall-clock time, and task accuracy. At each rule's most relaxed evaluated setting, relaxed verification on average accepts $1.34\times$ as many tokens per round but produces $1.54\times$ longer completions. For rules with higher acceptance lengths, tokens accepted only under relaxed verification tend to have low target-model probability, contributing to length inflation. For rules that reduce verifier rounds, accuracy typically drops substantially. Further analysis traces some failures to continued reasoning that exhausts the budget needed to deliver a final answer. Overall, accepted tokens per round alone is an unreliable measure of decoding speed under relaxed verification. Completion length and verifier rounds must also be reported to assess actual efficiency.

analysis.key_results: 最宽松设置下，有损验证平均每轮接受token数是无损的1.34倍，但生成长度是无损的1.54倍；仅在被有损验证接受的token往往目标模型概率较低；减少验证轮数的规则通常伴随准确率大幅下降；部分失败源于持续推理耗尽预算而未能给出最终答案。
analysis.main_contribution: 识别并揭示了有损推测解码中的生成长度膨胀现象，指出仅用每轮接受token数衡量速度的不可靠性。
analysis.method: 对12个target-drafter对应用现有的无训练有损验证规则，在相同提示下与无损验证对比，测量生成长度、验证轮数、实际耗时和任务准确率。

papers.abstract: Transformer prefill reuses weights across tokens and is dominated by matrix multiplication and activation data movement; single-token decode has limited reuse and is dominated by weight and KV-cache reads. We present FUTRANSFORMER, a CUDA implementation of a Llama-style Transformer block for NVIDIA Hopper GPUs. It applies CODA's GEMM-plus-epilogue approach to inference, adding direct KV-cache placement, folding the fixed RMSNorm gain into weights, writing FP8 output directly with delayed scaling, and supporting prefill without padding. Decode uses INT4 projection weights and an INT4 KV-cache copy. Weights and keys follow Tensor Core fragment layouts for direct dequantization into MMA operands without full intermediate tiles. A block-diagonal Hadamard transform reduces cache quantization error from outlier channels. On one H100, prefill is up to 1.48x faster than compiled PyTorch FP8 and reaches 1.29 PFLOP/s. For gate/up projection with SwiGLU at the 8B shape, our BF16 path is 1.13x faster than CODA. Our FP8 path is 2.02-2.18x faster than the evaluated BF16 CODA path. Across 8B and 70B shapes at batches 1-32, INT4 decode is 1.3-2.4x faster than the faster of PyTorch's BF16 and INT4 blocks at each point: 2.1-3.3x faster than compiled, CUDA-graphed BF16 and 1.3-6.3x faster than the same block using PyTorch's INT4 projection kernel, which targets a single query row and loses to BF16 at batch 32. It is also 31-51% faster than our FP8 path. Complete Llama-3.1-8B decode takes 2.8 ms per step at batch one, versus 8.1 ms for the compiled transformers implementation. Decoding every WikiText-2 token through the INT4 weight path raises perplexity from 6.24 to 7.23 with round-to-nearest weights or 6.99 with GPTQ in the same format; the rotated INT4 cache adds 0.20. The kernels match a quantized reference computation within 0.001 perplexity.

analysis.key_results: 在H100上预填充最高比编译的PyTorch FP8快1.48倍，达到1.29 PFLOP/s；8B和70B形状下INT4解码比PyTorch BF16和INT4块快1.3-2.4倍；完整Llama-3.1-8B解码每步2.8毫秒，而编译的transformers实现为8.1毫秒。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出FUTRANSFORMER，一个结合FP8预填充与INT4解码的Hopper GPU CUDA实现，显著提高了Transformer推理速度。
analysis.method: 采用CODA的GEMM+epilogue方法，融合RMSNorm增益、直接写入FP8输出、无填充预填充，解码使用INT4投影权重与INT4 KV缓存，并利用块对角Hadamard变换降低缓存量化误差。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出了一种针对NVIDIA Hopper GPU的Llama风格Transformer块CUDA实现，通过FP8预填充与INT4解码加速推理。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding has become a mainstream technique for accelerating large language model (LLM) inference by using a lightweight draft model to generate candidate tokens that are subsequently verified by the target model. However, agentic workloads introduce long and continuously evolving contexts and frequent multi-turn interactions. Under such workloads, we observe that existing draft models suffer from up to an 80% degradation in acceptance length, while maintaining their historical KV cache introduces substantial system overhead. In this paper, we identify the growing historical context as a common source of both problems and introduce DLite, a history-free speculative decoding framework for agentic AI. DLite directly reuses contextual hidden states from the target model and performs local speculative prediction without explicitly maintaining the historical context, transforming an increasingly complex modeling problem into local simple prediction problem. A lightweight sequential head further restores intra-block causal dependencies with low overhead. To effectively train this heterogeneous history-free architecture, we introduce a tailored two-stage training strategy. Experiments on general-purpose, long-context and agentic workloads show that DLite achieves 2-6 acceptance length and outperforms the state-of-the-art speculative decoding method, DSpark, up to 70%.

analysis.key_results: 在通用、长上下文和代理工作负载上达到 2-6 的接受长度，比最先进方法 DSpark 提升最高 70%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 DLite，一种面向代理 AI 的无历史投机解码框架，通过复用目标模型上下文隐藏状态和轻量顺序头，将复杂的上下文建模问题转化为局部简单预测问题。
analysis.method: DLite 直接复用目标模型的上下文隐藏状态进行局部投机预测，无需显式维护历史上下文；使用轻量顺序头恢复块内因果依赖；并采用两阶段训练策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: DLite 针对代理 AI 中长且持续演化的上下文，提出无历史投机解码框架，通过复用目标模型隐藏状态进行局部预测，避免显式维护历史 KV 缓存。

papers.abstract: Typed decision models often return more than a selected category. They also expose probabilities for each candidate and, sometimes, a separate confidence score. These fields support downstream decisions but may reveal information beyond a recipient's authorization. We introduce TUPLE-Bench (Typed decision models' Utility and Privacy Leakage Evaluation Benchmark), a benchmark of paired synthetic cases in which recipients may learn a coarse operational category but not its fine-grained cause. Across nine models, instructions to withhold the cause fail to protect it: 91.88%-99.93% of responses reveal the cause through direct selection or residual scores. Even when causes are excluded from the candidate set, full outputs enable 62.85%-75.35% recovery on held-out cases, compared with 51.04%-57.64% using only the selected category (50% chance). Full outputs also reduce mean downstream cost in all 27 model-task comparisons. However, confidence fields increase leakage without consistently reducing cost. We further introduce workflow-constrained privacy quantization (WCPQ), which reduces secret recovery while preserving the behavior and cost of specified downstream workflows. Our findings highlight the need to audit decision interfaces field by field and workflow by workflow.

analysis.key_results: 91.88%-99.93%的响应通过直接选择或残差分数泄露原因；仅用选定类别时恢复率为51.04%-57.64%，完整输出为62.85%-75.35%；置信度字段增加泄露但未一致降低效用。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入TUPLE-Bench基准和WCPQ方法，评估并减少Typed Decision Models的隐私泄露，同时保持下游工作流的行为和成本。
analysis.method: TUPLE-Bench基准和workflow-constrained privacy quantization (WCPQ)方法。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出TUPLE-Bench基准和WCPQ量化方法，评估并缓解类型化决策模型输出字段导致的隐私泄露问题。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于类型化决策模型的隐私-效用权衡及量化方法，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人领域，但提出的量化方法可能对高效推理和模型优化有一般性参考价值。

papers.abstract: Dense assistance methods such as speculative decoding repeatedly verify draft tokens with a target model, keeping target computation coupled to generation. We study sparse collaborative decoding, where a draft model generates most tokens and a target model is invoked only for short corrective segments. The key problem is deciding when to call the target. We show that local uncertainty is a weak trigger: entropy, negative log-likelihood, logit margin, top-$k$ mass, and velocity features give near-chance failure prediction, with AUC 0.50-0.53. In contrast, aggregate trajectory-shape features over the draft confidence path reach AUC 0.86 using a lightweight logistic predictor trained only from draft correctness labels. This induces a trigger-timing tradeoff: early calls have more leverage but weaker evidence, while later calls have stronger evidence but less ability to redirect the trajectory. Used online, learned sparse collaborative decoding improves over the best open-loop schedule by +5.3 to +20.0 accuracy points across five GSM8K draft-target pairs. On MATH-500, it gains 7.0-13.5 points when early prediction and target competence align, but loses when either is weak. On StrategyQA, it improves over open-loop by 5.0-8.3 points, showing transfer beyond arithmetics.

analysis.key_results: 在五个GSM8K草稿-目标模型对上，学习到的稀疏协作解码比最佳开环调度提高+5.3到+20.0个准确率点；在MATH-500上，当早期预测与目标能力对齐时提高7.0-13.5点，否则下降；在StrategyQA上比开环提高5.0-8.3点。
analysis.limitations: 在MATH-500上，若早期预测与目标能力不匹配则性能下降；触发时机存在权衡，早期调用证据弱，晚期调用纠正能力差。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出轨迹触发的稀疏协作解码，利用草稿模型生成路径的轨迹形状特征构建触发策略，在需要时调用目标模型进行校正，从而在保持或提升准确率的同时降低目标模型计算量。
analysis.method: 使用逻辑回归分类器基于草稿置信度路径的轨迹形状特征（而非局部不确定性）预测何时调用目标模型进行校正，在线使用该触发策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 研究稀疏协作解码中触发目标模型进行校正的策略，通过轨迹形状特征预测是否调用目标模型，以减少目标模型计算并提升解码质量。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable language-guided robot manipulation, but remain vulnerable to visual attacks that undermine user control over robot behavior. Prior studies optimize visual perturbations using fixed target supervision. However, the perturbation can change earlier actions and, in turn, the physical states reached later. As the attacked trajectory evolves, this supervision may no longer match the behavior needed at the states actually reached. Accurately matching these targets can therefore fail to advance the attacker-specified task. Even with suitable supervision, reducing average matching error does not ensure sustained task progress. The robot may still fail at a critical stage, and further updates can disrupt previously successful behavior. To address these limitations, we propose TRACO, a framework that enhances existing targeted visual attacks through closed-loop optimization. Its Execution-Driven Supervision rebuilds supervision for the states reached under attack to guide subsequent updates. Within this framework, Progress-Guided Selection focuses updates where progress stalls while maintaining supervision on the earlier behavior needed to reach that point. Experiments across VLA models and simulation environments show improved task-redirection success with TRACO, highlighting the security implications of closed-loop attack optimization.

analysis.key_results: 实验表明TRACO在多个VLA模型和仿真环境中提高了任务重定向成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出TRACO框架，通过执行驱动监督和进展引导选择解决现有视觉攻击中监督失效和任务进展不稳定的问题。
analysis.method: 闭环优化，包括执行驱动监督（重建攻击下实际到达状态的监督信号）和进展引导选择（聚焦于进展停滞阶段的更新）。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出TRACO框架，通过闭环优化增强针对VLA模型的视觉任务重定向攻击。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的安全性，研究视觉攻击下的机器人操作行为，与VLA主题高度相关。虽不涉及WAM，但涉及VLA模型的策略学习、机器人操作和视觉-语言方面，对本站VLA主题具有明确的关联性。

At test time (bottom), the same perturbation changes the robot’s actions under the user’s original instruction and can lead to different states (purple). papers.abstract: A memory test for a video world model should say whether the scene was set, whether the asked change was carried out, and whether the last frame shows the result. Current tests fold these into one number, so a low score is easy to read as forgetting. When the change is not carried out, the hidden state transition cannot appear, so the test is not really a test of memory. We introduce MIST, an evaluation that separates the change from the memory it should leave behind. The model first sets the scene while the change stays hidden, and only later is asked to show it, with leakage before that point kept under control. This separation locates the bottleneck: the model sets the scene but does not carry out the instructed change. The same gap appears in general memory evaluations. On that basis we propose M3-Agent (Make the Missing Move), which recursively revises the details of the input instruction so that the model successfully carries out the requested instruction. Relative to the baseline, it more than triples the MIST reveal score. On the benchmarks, WRBench's score T rises by 26.1% and MBench-T's score U by 52.7%. The method meets the problem from the execution side: it shows what the frozen model can do once the move is stated, and it sets a stricter baseline.

analysis.key_results: M3-Agent在MIST揭示分数上比基线提升超过三倍；在WRBench的T分数上提升26.1%，在MBench-T的U分数上提升52.7%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出MIST评估基准以分离场景设置与指令变更，定位视频世界模型的记忆瓶颈，并开发M3-Agent递归修正输入指令以提升模型执行能力。
analysis.method: MIST评估将变更隐藏于场景设置阶段，后期再要求展示，控制泄露；M3-Agent通过递归修正指令细节，使模型成功执行请求。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该工作提出了MIST评估基准和M3-Agent方法，通过将指令执行与记忆解耦，揭示了视频世界模型在未执行变更时记忆测试失效的问题，并显著提升了模型在多个基准上的表现。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对视频世界模型（WAM）的记忆与指令执行瓶颈，提出评估与改进方法，与本站的世界模型主题高度相关，但不涉及机器人动作预测或VLA。

papers.abstract: Agents built on vision language models (VLMs) now compete with learned policies on robot manipulation leaderboards. We ask how far a coding agent can go when it controls a robot instead of a computer, and where it stops. Our system, HexaShell, keeps the harness thin: it only turns the agent's commands into robot motion. The agent drives a robot with two arms through one command line. It sees three RGB cameras and knows their calibration. After each failed attempt, the agent reads the log, finds the cause, and writes or fixes small programs called tools. In this way it keeps what it learns as code, as a coding agent does when it fixes a failing test. The tools may use only what the robot observes. They use triangulation to find where objects are, relative to each other and to the gripper. If two cameras see the same point, the point lies where the two camera rays meet. If a point lies on a known plane, such as the table or the top of a block, it lies where its ray meets that plane. When the head camera is not enough, the robot moves a wrist camera to get a second view. We build the tools on only ten layouts of one seed per task, then freeze them and test them on ten new layouts of the same seed. We use Codex with GPT-6-Astra at medium reasoning effort. On all 42 RoboDojo tasks, HexaShell reaches a success rate of 39.7% and a progress score of 48.0, averaged in the same way as the leaderboard. This is a new state of the art on RoboDojo. The limit is contact, not reasoning: pushing reaches 92.5% and memory tasks 65.0%, but tight insertion only 8.3%. When the agent fails, it usually sees the failure but cannot make the motion work. We open source the tools evolved so far at https://github.com/HexaFuture/HexaShell.

papers.abstract: Lithography process drift can move a fabricated pattern outside its process window, producing unqualified scanning electron microscopy (SEM) morphology. We present LithoWorld, an endpoint world model for SEM-guided parameter recovery. Interior representative targets jointly determine qualified reference appearance and correction supervision. A causal predictive branch aligns currentimage features with endpoint representations, while a conditional flow policy generates a two-dimensional correction as an action chunk. The model learns from 173 groups of measured SEMs organized as focus-exposure maps, preserving unmeasured cells as unknown. On 200 test pairs from the 73-group subset, LithoWorld achieves 88.5% qualified-region success and 46.0% interior success, exceeding the strongest comparison method by 2.5 and 6.0 percentage points, respectively. Ablations separate the effects of target selection, endpoint alignment, and output parameterization. Qualitative SEM retrieval illustrates recovery to qualified interiors without requiring exact reference-coordinate matching.

analysis.key_results: 在73组子集的200个测试对上，合格区域成功率为88.5%，内部成功率为46.0%，分别比最强对比方法高2.5和6.0个百分点；消融实验分离了目标选择、端点对齐和输出参数化的作用。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出LithoWorld端点世界模型，结合代表性目标、因果预测分支和条件流策略，实现SEM引导的参数恢复。
analysis.method: 利用端点世界模型、因果预测分支对齐当前图像特征与端点表示，条件流策略生成二维校正动作块。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出LithoWorld，一个基于端点表示的世界模型，通过SEM图像指导光刻工艺窗口参数恢复。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作属于领域特定的世界模型，应用于光刻工艺，不涉及机器人动作预测或通用世界模型，与VLA/WAM主题无直接关系，但所提出的端点表示和条件生成机制可能对世界建模方法有参考价值。

papers.abstract: Rapid progress in embodied intelligence has enabled increasingly capable robots to follow language instructions and manipulate diverse objects. However, strong results in structured environments do not automatically transfer to open-world conditions, where clutter, occlusion, and changing viewpoints can obscure the spatial relationships required for action. To address this perceptual gap, a virtual active-perception paradigm is introduced. AWAM, an Active World-Action Model actively plans where to observe and imagines what will be seen along the planned trajectory before acting. Task-related virtual camera motion is predicted and used as a structured query into a geometry-conditioned world model, producing a reusable spatial prior for manipulation, which is later compressed into a fixed memory and fused with live observations through cross-attention for diffusion-based action prediction. AWAM achieves competitive success rates with 75.9% on LIBERO-Occ, 62.4% on LIBERO-Plus, 76.5% on RLBench-OG Occlusion1, and 94.4% in real-robot trials. These results support improved robustness to the evaluated occlusions and distribution shifts, addressing part of the gap between structured manipulation and less controlled environments.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO-Occ上成功率达75.9%，LIBERO-Plus上62.4%，RLBench-OG Occlusion1上76.5%，真实机器人试验94.4%。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入虚拟主动感知范式，设计主动世界-动作模型AWAM，主动规划观察轨迹并想象未来视图，生成可复用的空间先验用于扩散策略动作预测。

analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出主动世界-动作模型AWAM，通过主动规划观察视角并想象未来视图，构建空间先验以增强遮挡和分布偏移下的机器人操作鲁棒性。

papers.abstract: Robots manipulating objects in clutter must decide not only how to act, but also where to look. Although active camera motion can expose an occluded target, it may move the robot into an initial observation-state distribution that differs from the manipulation policy's training distribution. We identify this problem as first-frame distribution sensitivity: under perturbed starts in LIBERO, naively prepending camera repositioning to pi_0.5 reduces success from 46.3% to 11.5%. We introduce ActiveAlign, a data-adaptation framework that trains a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policy from the states at which active perception terminates. A learned viewpoint module first generates a camera trajectory. Offline, ActiveAlign uses closed-loop alignment to connect the trajectory endpoint to an existing demonstration, replays the remaining manipulation trajectory, and retains successful continuations for fine-tuning. At deployment, the same viewpoint module precedes the adapted VLA without modifying its architecture. Across 40 LIBERO tasks, ActiveAlign achieves 70.7% success with pi_0 and 72.7% with pi_0.5, outperforming their standard-training baselines by 40.0% and 26.4% respectively. Matched-state and data-matched controls support gains beyond prefix shortening and generic viewpoint augmentation; OpenVLA and GR00T N1 also show the same trend. Success rate under physical occlusion in real world increases from 35/90 to 83/90. These results show that active perception benefits manipulation when policy training is aligned with the observation and robot-state distribution induced by viewpoint selection.

analysis.key_results: 在 40 个 LIBERO 任务上，pi_0 成功率 70.7%，pi_0.5 成功率 72.7%，分别比标准训练基线高 40.0% 和 26.4%；真实世界物理遮挡下从 35/90 提升到 83/90。
analysis.main_contribution: 识别首帧分布敏感性，并引入 ActiveAlign 数据适配框架，在 VLA 训练中考虑主动感知的末端状态。
analysis.method: 学习视角模块生成相机轨迹，使用闭环对齐连接轨迹端点与现有演示，重放后续操控轨迹并保留成功延续进行微调。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 ActiveAlign 框架，使 VLA 策略与主动感知产生的观察状态分布对齐，从而提升杂乱环境中的操控成功率。

papers.abstract: When we say that a robot uses memory, does that memory actually play a role? Success-rate ablations alone cannot establish the use of task-relevant facts: they change information and computation together, while aggregate rates can hide offsetting gains and losses. We propose an Interventional Memory Evaluation Protocol (IMEP) for vision-language-action (VLA) systems to address four questions: (1) Does memory provide a net benefit? (2) Under what conditions does memory help? (3) Do changes to memory alter task outcomes? (4) Are these effects specific to task-relevant facts? At the retrieval interface, we compare target-fact substitutions with fact-preserving replacements, minimal numerical perturbations, and exact replicas, while assessing decision correctness separately from motor execution success. We evaluate within-episode, cross-episode, and agentic memory. In cross-episode learned-bank experiments, a one-unit-in-the-last-place (ULP) intervention, including its installation procedure, changes 11.9% of seed-paired outcomes, while changing key facts produces no clear additional effect over fact-preserving replacements. To examine when memory helps, we introduce ChainBench, where correct decisions require historical information unavailable in current observations. The full memory configuration raises task success from 39.1% to 74.3%, matching the oracle-decision condition under shared recorded executions. These results show that correct history can support robot decisions, but establishing whether a memory system realizes this benefit requires fact-specific evidence beyond aggregate success rates.

analysis.key_results: 跨情节实验中，单位最后一位干预改变了11.9%的种子配对结果；完整记忆配置将任务成功率从39.1%提升至74.3%，与共享记录执行下的预言决策条件相当。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了一种干预性记忆评估协议（IMEP），用于评估视觉-语言-动作系统中记忆的净收益、帮助条件、任务结果变化和任务相关事实特异性。
analysis.method: 在检索界面比较目标事实替换、事实保留替换、最小数值扰动和精确复制，并分离决策正确性和运动执行成功；同时引入ChainBench基准，要求基于历史信息做出正确决策。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种干预性评估协议，用于检验视觉-语言-动作系统中记忆是否真正提供了任务相关的益处。

papers.abstract: Modern deep learning systems increasingly rely on high-dimensional vector operations, in which large input and parameter vectors are repeatedly stored, transferred, and processed. Although substantial research has focused on reducing neural-network model size through pruning, quantization, knowledge distillation, and efficient architectures, the storage, memory-traffic, and communication costs associated with repeatedly presented high-dimensional input vectors remain important practical considerations, particularly in distributed and edge-computing environments. This paper proposes the SETAREH (Sorting-assisted Energy-concentrating Transform for Approximate Representation using Haar wavelets) transform, a Haar-wavelet-based sparsification approach for approximating the inner product between a fixed high-dimensional coefficient vector and successive input vectors. By applying the same sequence of permutations and Haar transforms to both vectors, SETAREH preserves the exact inner product before truncation. It then retains only a subset of the transformed coefficient-input pairs, reducing their representation cost while introducing a controllable approximation error. To evaluate SETAREH, we consider two complementary experimental settings: a synthetic Gaussian-vector baseline and a real apparent-age estimation task using a convolutional neural network on the APPA-REAL dataset. The results show that SETAREH can approximate the evaluated inner products using substantially fewer transformed coefficient-input pairs than the original vector dimension. The findings support its use as a potential structured data-representation method for repeated inner products with fixed weights, while the practical benefit depends on approximation accuracy and the cost of storing or transmitting permutation metadata.

analysis.key_results: 在合成高斯向量基线和APPA-REAL年龄估计任务上，SETAREH可以用远少于原始维度的变换对近似内积。
analysis.limitations: 实际收益取决于近似精度和存储/传输排列元数据的成本。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SETAREH变换，一种基于Haar小波的稀疏化方法，用于近似固定权重向量与输入向量的内积，同时保留截断前的精确内积并引入可控误差。
analysis.method: 对两个向量应用相同的排列和Haar变换序列，保留变换后系数-输入对的子集以降低表示成本。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出SETAREH变换，利用Haar小波稀疏化近似高维向量内积，减少存储和通信成本。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究高效内积近似，属于独立的高效推理/量化技术，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人策略，但对VLA/WAM中重复的固定权重向量运算可能有潜在应用价值。

papers.abstract: World-action models jointly predict actions and future world states, but long-horizon manipulation further requires language reasoning to plan subtask objectives, assess execution progress, and guide action selection. We present LAW, a closed-loop VLM--WAM framework that unifies language reasoning, action generation, and world modeling through semantic subtask progress. Within the LAW agent, a hybrid-expert vision-language model plans the remaining subtasks, estimates the values of and fuses actions proposed by a world-action model, and asynchronously assesses execution status to support continued execution and subtask transitions. Within the world-action model, Mixture-of-Transformer Experts integrates modality-specific and shared computation for joint video--action modeling. Dual-stream hierarchical visual memory maintains temporal context for both models, while subtask-local value learning aligns action evaluation with semantic objectives and preserves supervision from successful prefixes of failed trajectories. LAW achieves 94.21% average success across 50 RoboTwin tasks. Replacing the WAM backbone with OpenWAM-$alpha$ further raises the average success rate to 95.56%, establishing a new open-source state of the art on RoboTwin. Despite having only 2B parameters, our VLM also outperforms variants using Embodied-R1.5 and GPT-5.5 High. On three long-horizon real-robot tasks, LAW achieves 65% average success, compared with 28.33% for $pi_{0.5}$ and 25% for Fast-WAM.

analysis.key_results: LAW在50个RoboTwin任务上平均成功率为94.21%，替换为OpenWAM-α后达95.56%；仅2B参数的VLM优于Embodied-R1.5和GPT-5.5 High变体；在三个真实机器人长程任务上平均成功率为65%，对比π0.5为28.33%、Fast-WAM为25%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出LAW框架，通过语义子任务进度将语言推理、动作生成与世界建模相统一；在50项RoboTwin任务和三项真实机器人长程任务上取得领先成功率，并开源达到新SOTA。
analysis.method: 采用混合专家VLM规划剩余子任务、评估并融合世界-动作模型的动作；世界-动作模型中使用Mixture-of-Transformer Experts进行联合视频-动作建模；采用双流层次化视觉记忆和子任务局部价值学习。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: LAW提出一个闭环VLM-WAM框架，在语义子任务进度引导下统一语言推理、动作生成与世界建模，实现长程机器人操作。

papers.abstract: Long-horizon robotic tasks expose a fundamental limitation of current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models because their restricted temporal context pre-vents effective accumulation and reuse of past experiences. As a result, memory has become a fundamental component for enabling embodied agents to perform long-horizon reasoning and adaptive decision-making. This survey presents a systematic taxonomy of VLA memory mechanisms based on memory scope and persistence, categorizing existing approaches into five representative paradigms and one emerging frontier. Based on this taxonomy, we compare representative VLA memory systems in terms of memory characteristics, architectural com-plexity, and open-source maturity, revealing a clear trade-off in which increasing architectural complexity is generally accompanied by decreasing open-source ma-turity. Finally, we discuss the key challenges in building full-lifecycle memory systems, including efficient memory management and lifelong knowledge evolu-tion. Overall, this survey provides a unified perspective on memory architectures for VLA agents and offers insights into the development of lifelong embodied in-telligence.

analysis.key_results: 揭示架构复杂性与开源成熟度之间的权衡关系，即架构越复杂，开源成熟度通常越低。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了一种基于记忆范围和持续性的VLA记忆机制系统分类法，将现有方法归纳为五种代表性范式和一种新兴前沿。
analysis.method: 基于记忆范围和持续性的双重视角分类法，对代表性VLA记忆系统从记忆特征、架构复杂性和开源成熟度三个方面进行比较。

papers.abstract: Multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based mobile agents are rapidly evolving from conversational assistants into autonomous systems that perceive, reason over, and act on smartphone environments. This capability also exposes a new security risk: adversaries can embed malicious objectives in cross-application mobile content and steer agent behavior through indirect multimodal injection. Although prompt injection has been studied in desktop and web settings, its cross-modal properties in mobile ecosystems remain poorly understood, and existing security analyses are still limited. To close this gap, we introduce MobileInject, the first benchmark for evaluating mobile agents against multimodal injection attacks and reasoning-to-action security risks. MobileInject provides a high-fidelity interactive mobile evaluation framework covering 11 scenarios, 9 security-risk categories, and 108 executable risk instances. It further introduces Cross-Modal Consistency Injection to exploit corroboration across modalities, two enhanced attack methods, Multi-Role Collaborative Deception and Reasoning-Camouflage Injection, to intensify trust manipulation and reasoning hijacking, and a Reasoning Security Diagnosis Framework for fine-grained failure analysis. Systematic experiments show that mobile agents are broadly vulnerable to multimodal injection, and that many failures stem from reasoning hijacking at early stages. These findings establish MobileInject as a systematic cross-modal benchmark for studying and improving the security of mobile agents. Code release details are provided in the Appendix Open Science section.

analysis.key_results: 系统实验表明移动代理广泛易受多模态注入攻击影响，许多失败源于早期阶段的推理劫持。

papers.abstract: Recent advances in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and World Action Models (WAMs) have expanded the manipulation and whole body capabilities of individual robots. Yet a single robot remains limited by its embodiment, and many real world tasks require capabilities that can only emerge through cooperation. Existing multi robot frameworks largely emphasize task decomposition, allocation, and replanning, while providing limited support for adapting executable coordination when physical execution deviates from the intended behavior. We present CoEvolve, a framework that represents team coordination as executable code over fixed robot motor skills. CoEvolve introduces Verifier Guided Coordination Evolution, where a multimodal foundation model instantiates coordination strategies through motion primitives, semantic objectives, temporary robot roles, and bounded execution parameters. Physical verification evaluates each executed transition, rejected behaviors trigger structured coordination revision from an accepted checkpoint, and verified experience is retained to guide subsequent decisions. We evaluate CoEvolve with two simulated Unitree G1 humanoids transporting a freely supported rigid payload through constrained corridors. Across 15 base task runs with three multimodal backbone families, CoEvolve completes 8 tasks, with every backbone achieving end to end success. Additional evaluations yield verified placement on two additional corridor layouts and after both same-backbone and cross-backbone experience initialization, while exposing persistent limitations in motion precision and contact stability. These results support executable coordination as a practical interface for adapting long horizon multi robot collaboration under shared physical constraints.

analysis.key_results: 在模拟的Unitree G1人形机器人运输刚性负载通过受限走廊的15次基础任务中，三个多模态基础模型家族完成了8个任务，每个家族均实现端到端成功；在额外走廊布局和同/跨基础模型经验初始化下实现了验证放置，同时暴露出运动精度和接触稳定性的持续局限。

papers.abstract: Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models promise generalist robotic agents, yet consolidating skills learned across heterogeneous tasks and environments remains difficult: training data is fragmented across platforms, joint multi-task training suffers from interference, and model merging tends to introduce parameter conflicts or require architectural changes. We instead advocate a paradigm in which skills are first learned independently and then consolidated post hoc. To this end, we propose NestedVLA, which replaces parameter aggregation with parameter generation: a nested hypernetwork, conditioned on the target task, synthesizes task-adaptive action-expert parameters that compose with a frozen base VLA. Task-specific compressed VLM residuals are retained separately. This formulation enables flexible task-conditioned skill reuse while mitigating interference. Across three RL benchmarks (MetaWorld, ManiSkill, CALVIN), NestedVLA outperforms the strongest model-merging baseline by 41 pp on average, matches per-task fine-tuning within 1 pp on ManiSkill, and substantially closes the gap on CALVIN, pointing toward a storage-efficient route to skill consolidation. Code is available at https://github.com/WanyuGroup/NeurIPS2026-NestedVLA.

analysis.key_results: 在三个RL基准（MetaWorld、ManiSkill、CALVIN）上，NestedVLA平均优于最强模型合并基线41个百分点；在ManiSkill上与每任务微调相差1个百分点以内；在CALVIN上大幅缩小差距。

papers.abstract: A multimodal agent must decide whether visual evidence is worth acquiring, which candidate or resolution to query, and when further interaction can no longer change its decision. We study this problem under a strict free-metadata/paid-observation boundary, stochastic vector costs, and a frozen execution trace, and treat it as decision-certifiable active evidence acquisition. A Counterfactual Evidence Interaction Graph (CEIG) represents unary evidence value, signed second-order interaction, and directed conditional harm while maintaining explicit score enclosures for unresolved interactions; a decision-weighted enclosure objective tightens the bounds that can change action identity. Gap-directed refinement evaluates only interactions that can displace the incumbent acquisition and stops once an $\epsilon$-decision certificate shows that unresolved terms cannot change the selected action beyond a declared tolerance. The certificate is model-relative: it verifies policy-consistent optimality under the pinned learned score, and semantic quality is measured separately through post-freeze labels. Paired continuation rollouts learn the downstream value of paid previews, an online operational cost filter is separated from independent finite-policy-family trajectory certification, and an acquisition monitor with an independently implemented verifier binds every certificate to the frozen trace. On 640 cases split into 384/128/128 training, validation, and test cases, the controller reaches task score 0.842, grounding F1 0.816, evidence recall 0.873, 1.74 accepted calls, 286.5K visual tokens, and 742ms p95 latency. Dense replay of issued certificates shows 0.992 action agreement and a 0.988 certificate rate while evaluating 19.6 instead of 191.4 expensive interaction terms per decision.

papers.abstract: Precise grounding matters. It specifies which object is the target and where that object is, even in clutter and for tiny objects, and it has to be fast enough for closed-loop control. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAMs) take perception from general-purpose vision-language and video-generation backbones, which still fail in these settings. We introduce GroundingPI, a 4B grounding foundation model that generates points and boxes as quantized coordinates in a shared vocabulary. Training combines multimodal and spatial pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning with GRPO, using supervision from public datasets and dedicated data engines. Against 44 baselines across 34 grounding benchmarks spanning 11 perceptual capabilities, GroundingPI establishes a new state of the art, averaging 73.68%, above the larger GPT-6 Astra (71.54%). As a downstream visual backbone, GroundingPI improves performance on robotic manipulation and autonomous driving. On RoboTwin 2.0, it outperforms every mainstream backbone we evaluate in all four out-of-distribution settings, by up to 24.8% relative to the strongest backbone. On RoboCasa-GR1, GroundingPI trained with 50% of the demonstrations outperforms those baselines trained with 75%. On nuScenes, used as the visual backbone, GroundingPI attains an average open-loop L2 error of 0.296 m. We systematically analyze GroundingPI's pretraining in scale and data composition. Downstream autonomous driving and robotic manipulation improve as the pretraining is scaled. Analyzing the data recipe across these 11 perceptual capabilities shows dense grounding's substantial benefits for both, and OCR's potential as a catalyst for perceptual learning. These results support grounding as a perceptual foundation, and dedicated perceptual pretraining as a promising direction for foundation models of physical intelligence.

papers.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) grounding models serialize spatial predictions, introducing sequential latency and imposing a causal order on output tokens. We view grounding as visual evidence extraction: objects, locations, and spatial relations are jointly constrained by the image and query, yet their dependencies do not imply an intrinsic left-to-right generation order. This distinction makes bidirectional diffusion a natural fit, allowing spatial hypotheses to emerge in parallel and be jointly refined through iterative denoising. We introduce GroundAnything, a 4B-parameter grounding foundation model that reconciles fast parallel decoding with precise localization through blockwise denoising. Training combines grounding pretraining from public datasets and dedicated data engines, direct AR-to-diffusion conversion with joint AR and diffusion objectives, supervised fine-tuning, and GRPO-based reinforcement post-training. Across 30 grounding benchmarks, our autoregressive variant, GroundAnything-VLM, establishes a new overall state of the art among similarly sized models at 72.42%, remaining competitive with GPT-6 Astra (71.35%). With entropy-guided decoding, GroundAnything also surpasses the prior state of the art at this scale, averaging 61.75% versus 53.32% for the fast MTP-based LocateAnything model. We further explore decoding strategies, showing that an optional self-speculative mode achieves a $4.51\times$ speedup over the AR counterpart with a 0.74 percentage-point drop in COCO F1mIoU. Infrastructure experiments show that progressive inference optimizations translate parallel decoding into practical speedups. These support efficient visual grounding in latency-sensitive real-world systems.

analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出GroundAnything，一个40亿参数的视觉定位基础模型，将定位视为视觉证据提取，采用双向扩散并行解码，并进一步通过自推测模式实现相较于自回归模型4.51倍的加速。

papers.abstract: Dexterous grasp synthesis has advanced rapidly in generating stable and physically plausible hand poses, but real-world manipulation requires grasps that preserve the function implied by the task. We study open-vocabulary task-oriented dexterous grasp generation, where a robot must infer functional intent from free-form language, ground it in multi-view visual observations and object geometry, and generate an executable high-degree-of-freedom grasp. We present OpenDexGrasp, a unified data and generative modeling framework for this setting. OpenDexVerse provides dual-source supervision organized by the Coverage-to-Alignment (C2A) Recipe: OpenDex-Scale offers large-scale semantic and geometric coverage through automatic grasp synthesis and vision-language annotation, while OpenDex-Align supplies high-quality embodied alignment through human teleoperation and category-level transfer. OpenDexGrasp learns a shared perception-action latent representation that couples open-vocabulary vision-language context with dexterous action generation. Affordance grounding and grasp generation provide complementary supervision over this latent space, enabling direct generation of task-consistent dexterous grasps without a separate affordance-to-pose inference stage. Extensive simulation and real-robot experiments demonstrate improved functional alignment, physical feasibility, generalization to unseen categories, and real-world execution success. Additional details and videos are available at https://opendexgrasp.github.io/.

analysis.key_results: 模拟和真实机器人实验表明，在功能对齐、物理可行性、对未见类别的泛化以及真实世界执行成功率方面均有提升。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding speeds up large language model inference: a small drafter proposes several tokens, and the target model verifies them in one parallel pass. Drafting a tree lets the target verify many alternative continuations at once. DDTree builds such trees from the block-diffusion drafter DFlash, but scores each position independently of the tokens earlier in its branch; Domino conditions on those tokens but drafts only a single chain. DominoTree combines the two: a training-free best-first tree scored by Domino's path-dependent causal correction, restricted to top-M candidates. In a research harness at temperature zero, it averages 5.33x speedup over autoregressive (AR) decoding on Qwen3-4B and 6.89x on Qwen3-8B, peaking at 8.77x; across temperatures it is 20-26% faster than Domino on Qwen3-4B and 27-36% on Qwen3-8B, and 11-20% faster than the stronger of DDTree and its cost-aware variant CaDDTree. A controlled decomposition attributes +10.1% (Qwen3-4B) and +10.7% (Qwen3-8B) accepted length to the correction, and +4.7% and +4.4% to conditioning on the realized path. Served in SGLang on one RTX 5090, it reaches 4.11x and 4.83x AR at batch size 1, 1.17x and 1.09x the speed of Domino's chain, and up to 1.71x AR on 8K-token HELMET summarization, 14-21% above the chain. The lead holds at 2 concurrent requests but reverses from 8 onward, where the chain sustains more goodput despite DominoTree's 28% higher acceptance. DominoTree accepts more tokens than the chain in every serving setting. On the hybrid Gated-DeltaNet Qwen3.6-27B, correct output requires tree-aware recurrent verification; with it, DominoTree matches the chain at batch size 1 (4.58x versus 4.54x AR) and reaches up to 2.11x AR at long context, 15% above the chain.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上平均加速5.33x和6.89x；在SGLang服务中批量大小为1时达到4.11x和4.83x的AR速度，在8K-token HELMET摘要任务上最高1.71x AR。

papers.abstract: How can pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models retain long-horizon visual histories with high-frequency updates without sacrificing efficiency? Existing approaches rely on external memory management, which restrains either the memory horizon or the reactiveness of pretrained policies. To this end, we present NativeMEM, a VLA policy that features long-term and real-time updated memory. At its core is an efficient memory encoding scheme, Native Memory Compression, which repurposes the VLA's own vision encoder to compress each historical frame from each camera view into a single token. Appended to the input sequence, these memory tokens enable the pretrained VLA to attend over long-term history with negligible latency overhead, requiring neither an external planner nor a freshly initialized memory module. To align the memory tokens with the pretrained policy, we first develop a generic memory tokenizer under the supervision of a frozen VLA on memory-demanding data, and then unfreeze the VLA for task-specific fine-tuning. NativeMEM consistently outperforms prior methods, boosting success rates from 32.4% to 84.0% in simulation and up to 98.7% on real robots, while maintaining low inference latency and GPU memory usage. Notably, NativeMEM exhibits high data efficiency by achieving competitive results with prior arts using only 20% of the training data.

analysis.main_contribution: 提出Native Memory Compression方案，将预训练VLA自身视觉编码器用于压缩历史帧为单token，并设计了记忆tokenizer与任务微调流程，使VLA能以低延迟和低显存支持长期实时记忆。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide a natural language interface to robot control, but the mapping from language to behavior is often brittle and unintuitive: semantically similar instructions can induce drastically different behaviors, while some capabilities may not be elicitable through prompting alone. As a result, both human instructions and zero-shot language models can fail to reliably steer VLAs toward successful task execution. In this work, we propose a framework that interactively searches for language sequences that improve closed-loop VLA task performance, distills these sequences into a test-time language feedback policy (LFP), and learns an improvement head that predicts when language steering will improve performance. We conformalize this improvement head to prevent harmful steering interventions, where the LFP decreases task performance relative to the original instruction on out-of-distribution scenarios. Crucially, our approach operates on arbitrary frozen pre-trained VLAs, requiring neither access to the original training distribution nor fine-tuning of the underlying model. On seen environments, our conformalized LFP improves base VLA performance by 24.7% in simulation and 65.0% in hardware. On visual and semantic perturbations with calibration samples, our conformalized LFP has strong harmlessness guarantees, and produces recovery behaviors not observed with open-loop prompting.

analysis.key_results: 在已见环境中，保形化LFP在仿真中提升VLA基础性能24.7%，在硬件中提升65.0%；在带有校准样本的视觉和语义扰动下，具有很强的无害性保证，并产生开环提示中未观察到的恢复行为。

analysis.method: 交互式搜索语言序列，蒸馏为测试时语言反馈策略，学习改进头并进行保形化以防止有害引导；该方法适用于任意冻结的预训练VLA，无需访问原始训练分布或微调模型。

papers.abstract: Enabling embodied agents to imagine future states is essential for robust and generalizable visual navigation. Yet, state-of-the-art systems typically rely on modular designs that decouple navigation planning from visual world modeling, which often induces state-action misalignment and weak adaptability in novel or dynamic scenarios. We propose UniWM, a unified, memory-augmented world model that integrates egocentric visual foresight and planning within a single multimodal autoregressive backbone. UniWM explicitly grounds action selection in visually imagined outcomes, tightly aligning prediction with control. Meanwhile, a hierarchical memory mechanism fuses short-term perceptual cues with longer-term trajectory context, supporting stable and coherent reasoning over extended horizons. Extensive experiments on four challenging benchmarks (Go Stanford, ReCon, SCAND, HuRoN) and the 1X Humanoid Dataset show that UniWM improves navigation success rates by up to 30%, substantially reduces trajectory errors against strong baselines, generalizes zero-shot to the unseen TartanDrive dataset, and scales naturally to high-dimensional humanoid navigation. These results position UniWM as a principled step toward unified, imagination-driven embodied navigation. The code and models are available at https://github.com/UWMILab/UniWM.

analysis.key_results: 在四个基准（Go Stanford, ReCon, SCAND, HuRoN）和1X Humanoid数据集上，导航成功率最高提升30%，轨迹误差显著降低，并能零样本泛化到TartanDrive数据集，同时可扩展到高维人形导航。

papers.abstract: Trustworthy robot behavior requires not only high levels of task success but also that the robot can reliably quantify how likely it is to succeed. To this end, we present a first-of-its-kind study of confidence calibration in vision-language-action (VLA) foundation models, which map visual observations and natural language instructions to low-level robot motor commands. We establish a confidence estimation baseline for VLAs, examine how task success relates to calibration error and how calibration evolves over time, and introduce two lightweight techniques to remedy the miscalibration we observe: prompt ensembles and action-wise Platt scaling. Our aim in this study is to begin to develop the tools and conceptual understanding necessary to render VLAs trustworthy via reliable uncertainty quantification.
